t: Chipping Away: From Monolith to Self-Organizing Tools with the Accessibility Tree
s: Refactoring a monolithic toolset into a self-organizing Python package by transplanting functionality, exemplified by integrating the accessibility tree for enhanced AI understanding, driven by a 'chisel-strike' philosophy of incremental improvement.
sub: Accessibility tree for AI semantic understanding
Manual registry vs. auto-discovery of tools (`__init__.py` role)
